faqs.question: What is the gross profit margin formula?
faqs.answer: Gross Profit Margin = ((Revenue - Cost) / Revenue) × 100. For example, if you sell something for $100 that cost $60, your gross margin is 40%.

faqs.question: What is the difference between margin and markup?
faqs.answer: Margin is profit as a percentage of revenue. Markup is profit as a percentage of cost. A 40% margin equals a 66.7% markup. They measure the same profit from different bases.

faqs.question: What is a good profit margin?
faqs.answer: It varies by industry. Retail averages 2-5%, SaaS can be 70%+, restaurants aim for 3-9%. A healthy gross margin for most small businesses is 40-60%.
